description: This file defines a Java interface for reading accounting rules within the Fineract accounting service module. It includes method signatures for retrieving all accounting rules and retrieving a specific rule by ID.

classes.name: AccountingRuleReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for retrieving accounting rule data, including all rules and specific rule by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccountingRules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all accounting rules, optionally filtered by a search string and the presence of association parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAccountingRuleById
methods.description: Retrieves a single accounting rule by its unique identifier.
